name: Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Regular student or researcher admitted to (or seeking admission at) a government-approved educational institution in Bangladesh.
Bank guarantee documents demonstrating financial capacity.

evidence_required.document: Invitation/offer letter from a Bangladeshi educational institution
Declaration or recommendation letter from the school

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, multiple entries, extendable up to the full course tenure via the Department of Immigration and Passport (DIP)

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Bangladesh (High Commission of Bangladesh, Ottawa) -- Student Visa: up to 1 year, multiple entries, extendable to course tenure via DIP; requires institution invitation/offer letter, school declaration/recommendation, bank guarantee documents; fees vary by reciprocity (e.g. Canadian passport holders CAD 200 multiple-entry / CAD 100 single-entry), non-refundable

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bangladesh). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 sourced from an official diplomatic mission. Fees are reciprocity-based and vary by applicant nationality, per the source's own explicit statement -- no single flat fee figure exists, so none is asserted here. No dedicated post-study work-visa conversion pathway was found; switchable_to bd_work_permit reflects the general possibility of a subsequent employer-sponsored application, not a dedicated graduate-route mechanism.
